reason: The predicate "treats" is too strong for what the abstract states. The quote only says that stem-cell therapy "have been evaluated for safety and efficacy in pre-clinical and clinical studies." This describes evaluation/study of the treatment, not actual treatment of the disease. The abstract explicitly states "Many treatments...have been evaluated" and later notes that "few therapies are unlikely to even partially reverse the disease." The evidence shows stem-cell therapy is under investigation for CLN1, but does not establish that it treats CLN1 disease.
